T2.5.title: World data
T2.5.summary: Per-region world data decoded from the ADF (src/assets/image): region_N.json (N = 0-9) holds the 32x64 region map of sector ids and the region's 256 terra entries (feature type = high nibble, mask-application mode = low nibble); sectors_outdoor.json / sectors_indoor.json hold the shared 256-sector pools (16x8 tile ids each). Review by looking at previews/: region_N_map.png is the game's own magic-map colouring (1 px per tile, 1024x256), region_N_collision.png colours each 8x8 sub-tile by terrain feature type (2048x1024), region_N_maskmode.png colours each tile by mask mode; previews/legend.json explains the colours. Landmark positions in the items are grid (col, row) from the door/extent tables: pixel (col*16, row*8) in the map preview.

items.title: region_N.json — 10 regions, 32x64 sector grids, 256 terra entries
items.look_for: 10 files, one per file_index row: F1 snowy, F2 witch wood, F3 swampy, F4 plains and rocks, F5 desert, F6 bay/city/farms, F7 volcanic, F8 forest and wilderness (outdoor, 2x4 layout: xreg 0/64, yreg 0/32/64/96), F9 inside of buildings and F10 dungeons and caves (indoor, xreg 0, yreg 128, same sector block 96 and region block 192). region_map.grid is 32 rows x 64 cols of sector ids (map_mem[row*128 + col + xreg]); terra.entries has 256 tiles, each with maptag, feature_type, mask_mode, subtile_mask, big_color.

items.title: sectors_outdoor.json / sectors_indoor.json — 256 sectors of 8x16 tile ids
items.look_for: Two pools: block 32 (outdoor, regions 0-7) and block 96 (indoor, regions 8-9), each 64 blocks = 32768 bytes = 256 sectors x 128 bytes. sectors[sec] is 8 rows of 16 tile ids (sector_mem[sec*128 + row*16 + col]). Sector 0 is what empty (unused) map cells point at.

items.title: terra entries — byte layout and the two nibbles of byte 1
items.look_for: Open terra.fields: each 4-byte entry is {maptag, terrain, tiles, big_colors} (terrain.c writer). Byte 1 splits into feature_type = high nibble (what px_to_im returns when the tile's sub-tile mask bit is set: 1 impassable, 2 sink, 3 slow/brush per the fmain.c comment) and mask_mode = low nibble (k in the sprite-masking switch: 0 never ... 7; values 8-15 match no case and always mask). terra.feature_type_labels lists the 4 named types, terra.mask_mode_labels the 8 switch cases. Tiles 0-127 come from terra block 149+terra1, 128-255 from 149+terra2.

items.title: previews/legend.json — colour key for the preview renders
items.look_for: Three preview kinds. map: pagecolors[big_color & 31], the same 5-bit colour the magic map (plotsect) uses, 1 px per tile. collision: 16 feature-type colours (0 open = near-black, 1 impassable = red, 2 sink = blue, 3 slow/brush = green, others as listed), 2x4 px per tile, one per 8x8 sub-tile. maskmode: 8 switch-case colours plus white for 8-15 (mask always applied), 1 px per tile.

items.title: Region 0 — F1 snowy region (NW quarter of the overworld)
items.look_for: Map: the snowy north-west — a large white snowfield cut by blue rivers, green land to the south, dark-blue sea around; the dragon cave door sits at grid (19, 27) and the two crystal palace doors at (61, 27) on the eastern edge. Collision: sea and rivers read as sink (blue), mountains/walls as impassable (red), most land open (near-black).

items.title: Region 1 — F2 witch wood (NE quarter)
items.look_for: Map: a forested island with dense dark-green woods, roads and a few buildings; the witch's castle door is at grid (40, 27), north keep at (30, 26) and maze cave 1 at (37, 26). Collision: dense forest/buildings blocked (red), sea sink (blue).

items.title: Region 2 — F3 swampy region (W, second row)
items.look_for: Map: the western swamp lands with dark marsh patches and forest, coast to the west; the swamp shack door is at grid (36, 19), lakeside keep at (47, 14), west keep at (30, 27). Collision: swamp/brush shows as slow (green) and sink (blue) patches, keeps as impassable (red).

items.title: Region 3 — F4 plains and rocks; Tambry (E, second row)
items.look_for: Map: the plains east of the swamp with roads and many keeps. The village of Tambry (hero start 19036,15755) is at grid (10, 29) with the village doors at (9, 29) — bottom-left of the region; friendly inn at (2, 27), crag keep at (12, 18), mammoth manor at (32, 18), glade keep at (38, 10), sea keep at (44, 14), coast keep at (2, 5), troll cave at (24, 14). Collision: rocks/mountains impassable (red), coast sink (blue).

items.title: Region 4 — F5 desert area (W, third row)
items.look_for: Map: a large tan/orange desert (the Burning Waste) with green land around it and sea to the west; the desert fort door is at grid (17, 16), oasis #1 at (26, 11), the tombs stair at (52, 11). Collision: desert mostly open (near-black), sea sink (blue), fort/tomb walls impassable (red).

items.title: Region 5 — F6 bay / city / farms; Marheim (E, third row)
items.look_for: Map: a large dark-blue bay in the middle, a grey walled castle with an orange field-grid of farms around it on the west shore, brown mountain ridges further west and south-east. The main castle door is at grid (21, 18) with the city doors just north of it (city #10 at (22, 17)); farm keep at (25, 24), cabin #1 at (20, 5), point keep at (46, 18). Collision: bay sink (blue), castle/city walls and mountains impassable (red).

items.title: Region 6 — F7 volcanic (SW quarter)
items.look_for: Map: a dark-grey volcanic waste with scattered red-orange lava spots, green land on its rim, sea beyond. The fiery_death zone (map_x 8802-13562, map_y 24744-29544) covers grid cols 34-52, rows 0-19; the doom tower door is at grid (44, 17), pass fort at (23, 10), gate fort at (25, 2), plain fort at (47, 3). Collision: volcanic rock largely impassable (red) with open paths; sea sink (blue).

items.title: Region 7 — F8 forest and wilderness (SE quarter)
items.look_for: Map: the south-eastern wilderness — forest, brown mountain ridges and rivers, coast to the east and south. Lonely keep is at grid (43, 28), river keep at (13, 11), elf glade at (20, 4), cabin #9 at (25, 15), the unreachable castle at (25, 7). Collision: mountains/forest impassable (red), rivers and sea sink (blue).

items.title: Region 8 — F9 inside of buildings (indoor pool, terra sets under+furnish / inside+astral)
items.look_for: Map: black background with grey building floor plans, room grids and corridors laid out in rows; a blue rectangular block (the astral plane) at grid cols 36-49, rows 2-10 in the upper right. Door interiors: main castle at grid (22, 3), city #10 at (25, 2), cabin #1 at (28, 24), stargate at (43, 18). Collision: walls impassable (red), floors open (near-black).

items.title: Region 9 — F10 dungeons and caves (same map/sectors as region 8, terra under+cave / inside+astral)
items.look_for: Map: the same layout as region 8 (both file_index rows load sector block 96 and region block 192) but coloured/flagged with the cave terra set: the winding cave passages in the upper left and centre are the dungeons. Cave interiors: tombs at grid (4, 14), dragon cave at (25, 12), troll cave at (10, 8), maze cave 1 at (4, 8), spider exit at (17, 11). Collision: cave walls impassable (red).
